title: Grade 3
summary: Compound time, demisemiquavers, extended ledger lines, octave transposition, keys to four sharps/flats with both minor forms, interval qualities.

units.title: Simple and compound time
units.summary: Compound time signatures and grouping of notes and rests.

units.title: Demisemiquavers and upbeats
units.summary: Demisemiquavers and their rests; optional upbeat starts.
refinements: Book §5 (upbeat starts) is an optional enrichment node: useful for reading music, not an explicit current outcome.

units.title: Ledger lines and octave transposition
units.summary: Notes beyond two ledger lines, octave signs and transposing at the octave between treble and bass.

units.title: Keys to four sharps or flats; both minor forms
units.summary: Melodic minor; E and A♭ major; six new minor keys; key signatures, tonic triads and degrees.
refinements: Melodic minor (book Grade 2 §§9, 11) is taught here, first in A, E and D minor, as the official syllabus requires it from Grade 3.

units.title: Interval qualities and expression
units.summary: Major, minor and perfect intervals above the tonic; Grade 3 terms; reading a melody.

nodes.title: Simple or compound?
nodes.objective: Tell simple time from compound time by how the beat divides.

nodes.title: 6/8, 9/8 and 12/8
nodes.objective: Read compound duple, triple and quadruple time signatures.

nodes.title: Grouping notes in compound time
nodes.objective: Beam notes in dotted-crotchet beats and use ties to show beats.

nodes.title: Grouping rests in compound time
nodes.objective: Write rests for silent beats and part-beats in compound time, accepting both forms of a silent beat.

nodes.title: Triplets or compound time?
nodes.objective: Compare triplets in simple time with the same rhythm in compound time.

nodes.title: Practice: Beats in threes
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: Grade 2 foundations
nodes.objective: Revisit earlier material so it stays fresh.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Beats in threes
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Demisemiquavers and their rests
nodes.objective: Recognise the demisemiquaver and its rest and relate them to longer values.

nodes.title: Beaming very short notes
nodes.objective: Beam demisemiquavers within beats and arrange their rests.

nodes.title: Upbeat starts
nodes.objective: Optional: understand music that begins before the first bar-line.

nodes.title: Practice: Very short notes
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Very short notes
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Beyond two ledger lines
nodes.objective: Read and write notes with more than two ledger lines.

nodes.title: Octave signs
nodes.objective: Read 8va and 8vb signs as an alternative to many ledger lines.

nodes.title: Transposing at the octave between treble and bass
nodes.objective: Rewrite a melody an octave higher or lower in the other clef.

nodes.title: Practice: Higher, lower, an octave away
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Higher, lower, an octave away
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: The melodic minor
nodes.objective: Build A, E and D melodic minor ascending and descending.

nodes.title: E and A flat major
nodes.objective: Build E and A♭ major and write their key signatures.

nodes.title: B, F sharp and C sharp minor
nodes.objective: Build B, F♯ and C♯ minor in both forms.

nodes.title: G, C and F minor
nodes.objective: Build G, C and F minor in both forms.

nodes.title: Key signatures, tonic triads and degrees to four
nodes.objective: Write all key signatures to four sharps/flats, their tonic triads and degree numbers.

nodes.title: Practice: More keys, two minor forms
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: More keys, two minor forms
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Perfect intervals
nodes.objective: Recognise perfect unisons, 4ths, 5ths and octaves above the tonic.

nodes.title: Major and minor intervals
nodes.objective: Name 2nds, 3rds, 6ths and 7ths above the tonic as major or minor in major and minor keys.

nodes.title: Grade 3 terms
nodes.objective: Understand the Grade 3 performance terms.

nodes.title: Speed and time
nodes.objective: Learn six words about speed and time: adagietto, largamente, stringendo, alla breve, comodo and rubato.

nodes.title: Strong words
nodes.objective: Learn six strong words: forza, deciso, risoluto, pesante, marcato and energico.

nodes.title: Gentle words, and how much
nodes.objective: Learn four gentle words, and two words that say how much: delicato, leggiero, tranquillo, semplice, ben and tanto.

nodes.title: Feelings
nodes.objective: Learn six words of feeling: agitato, mesto, triste, amore, anima and animato.

nodes.title: Style and character
nodes.objective: Learn four words of style: marziale, scherzando, brio and ritmico.

nodes.title: Always, suddenly and in order
nodes.objective: Learn six more words: sempre, subito, prima, seconda, volta and ad libitum.

nodes.title: Looking closely at a melody (Grade 3)
nodes.objective: Answer questions about an original melody in compound time.

nodes.title: Practice: Naming intervals exactly
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Grade review
nodes.objective: Cumulative spaced review of the whole grade before the unit challenge and grade assessment.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Naming intervals exactly
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Grade 3 assessment
nodes.objective: An independent, hint-free assessment that samples every Grade 3 outcome and earlier essentials.
